description: A bearded man in a tan turban and a fringed woolen shawl stands in a mudbrick doorway, holding a short staff with a metal head. Armed men with spears stand behind him in the dark interior, and a woman in a dark headband and a second woman stand at his side. Sheep crowd the foreground, and a river with palms and distant mudbrick houses lies under a dark, stormy sky. The style is oil-painted, with no visible text, frame or wall-mounted canvas, and the painting runs edge to edge.
